activity_summary: About one, a casement opened over you. Anne asked who you were talking to. You said a girl at a window, not fourteen, and quick. She told you to let her be quick, and to come to bed. You did not go in then.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered, and did not come in.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked who, asked how long, and told him to come to bed.

entities.name: the orchard scene
entities.context: Mentioned in A girl at a window

facets.activity: Answered Anne at the casement and stayed out
